name: archirules
description: A method for running software projects: decisions, open questions, phases and verification discipline as first-class artefacts

plugins.name: archirules
plugins.description: Runs a project through a decision register (ADR), an open-questions register (OQ), a phase register whose acceptance criteria are agreed before the work, and a verification register. Enforces the discipline behind them: refuse rather than guess, name the costs of every decision, and prove a gate can fail before trusting it.
